title: Sea Glass on 30A | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home!* Pet Friendly- subject to approval and a $250 nonrefundable fee* 175 Yards to Bullard Beach and Beach Highlands* 6 Fun Pug Bikes Included* 2 Master Suites* Surrounded by lush vegetation* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home!* Pet Friendly- subject to approval and a $250 nonrefundable fee* 175 Yards to Bullard Beach and Beach Highlands* 6 Fun Pug Bikes Included* 2 Master Suites* Surrounded by lush vegetation* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Escape to your home away from home at Sea Glass on 30A, a beautifully designed, pet-friendly, three-level retreat tucked south of Highway 30A in quiet Dune Allen Beach. Surrounded by lush vegetation and offering nearly 1,000 square feet of outdoor porch space, this professionally decorated home sleeps up to 10 guests with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and two primary suites, plus an in-home elevator for easy access. Enjoy two beach access points less than a five-minute walk away, quick access to Topsail State Park, and peaceful neighborhood vibes with minimal traffic. Inside, you’ll find stylish living spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, Smart TVs, free WiFi, and inviting areas to unwind—from shaded porches and a swing bed to beautiful view seating and treehouse-style decks. Outside perks include 6 adult bikes, a gas grill, and plenty of space for alfresco dining or sunset lounging. Thoughtfully curated for comfort and relaxation, Sea Glass on 30A is the perfect setting to slow down, reconnect, and make lasting beach memories.The Bed Setup:2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin BedsLiving Room: Sleeper Sofa3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions: Seapointe Serenity is perfectly situated, with Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away from the East. Located in an upscale area of Hwy 30A, this pristine house is perched between Destin and Seaside. Just a 13-minute drive to Grand Boulevard Town Center with over 35 shops and restaurants as well as the all-new state-of-the-art Boulevard 10 Movie Theater. Bike down to Blue Mountain Creamery for a cone or meander along the miles of trails! The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A comprises 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique among all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
